pre_registered_reading: Threshold: at least 20% of reference notes in either corpus carrying at least one MATERIAL discrepancy on the pre-registered severity axis. Either outcome was publishable; meeting it made the reference-quality ablation's original-vs-verified comparison a reported result.
denominator_note: fractions are over the KEPT master-corpus consults (53 PriMock v2.1 + 45 ACI sheets that passed extraction critique); dropped consults have no audited fact sheet and are not audited.

examples.detail: Note describes the vomit as "mainly bilous". The patient described normal food-coloured vomit; bilious vomiting is a fabricated character with obstructive connotations.
examples.fact_ref: The vomit was normal food colour with no blood.
examples.evidence: just normal vomit, yeah. No no <UNSURE>blood</UNSURE>, no.

examples.detail: No record that the patient is tolerating oral fluids despite reduced appetite - the pertinent positive that licenses conservative home management.
examples.fact_ref: Loss of appetite with reduced food intake, but able to tolerate/hold down fluids.
examples.evidence: I haven't been eating as much, but I've been able to hold down fluids

examples.detail: "Imp: gastroenteritis" states the diagnosis definitively; the clinician said the patient "may have" gastroenteritis, mainly viral with bacteria only a possibility. Note also omits the viral/bacterial framing and the tentative link to the takeaway.
examples.fact_ref: Working impression, stated tentatively: the patient may have gastroenteritis (a tummy bug/infection), suspected to relate to the Chinese takeaway.
examples.evidence: it seems like you may have something, uh, called gastroenteritis

examples.detail: The clinician expressed the diagnosis tentatively ('i think you've got a little contusion right here'), but the note records the impression as a flat, definite diagnosis with no hedging.
examples.fact_ref: The contusion diagnosis was stated as definite and confirmed.
examples.evidence: i think you've got a little contusion right here

examples.detail: The note records 'No tenderness over the proximal phalanx'; the clinician said no tenderness over the proximal JOINT. The pertinent negative is relocated from a joint to a bone shaft, which changes which structure was cleared.
examples.fact_ref: Pertinent negative: no tenderness over the proximal joint.
examples.evidence: i do n't feel any tenderness over your proximal joint

examples.detail: The note omits the active movement findings: the patient could flex, extend, and oppose the finger to the thumb. These normal findings are what exclude tendon injury and license conservative management.
examples.fact_ref: The patient can flex the finger. / The patient can extend the finger.
examples.evidence: can you bend your finger for me ? [patient] yeah
